title: Falaknuma Palace
geometryBasis: The mapped relation locates the north facade, its shoulder returns, the open court and each wing. The published photo sets the north gallery, step and arch proportions.
sectionBasis: The 1898 view shows open two-storey columns, the central classical pediment and low balustrades above a three-arch podium and paired stairs.
limitations: North stairs and columns follow the published photo and mapped envelope. Reliefs, capitals, rear openings and interiors are generalized where dimensions are unavailable.

The 30-metre digital surface model includes roof and canopy returns and does not resolve terrace edges or stair risers. The outer grounds and detached approach gateway are outside the structure scope.
